thread:
Maria: Thanks everyone for coming to the all-hands. Quick catch-up thread for outstanding Qs and who owns them. I'll add a few links below.

Elena: Thanks — adding the roadmap link: https://internal.redwood.ai/roadmap (slides are attached in the recording). For clarity: Dedicated limited GA target is week of 2025-05-12, not global GA. We'll ramp capacity after the private beta.

Derek: Can we get a bind on the Dedicated SLA numbers? Customers want 99.9 vs 99.95 clarity.

Elena: SLA discussion: 99.9 is baseline for reserved capacity at launch; 99.95 is for enterprise tier (negotiated). Action: @Derek to draft SLA appendix and send to legal by 2025-04-15.

Ajay: Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) GA — when can sales say 'GA' to customers?

Sophia: Private GA depends on KMS/HSM integrations finishing. Target internal cutoff: 2025-06-01 for VPC GA; on-prem will be phased (pilot partners first). Action: @Sophia to post deployment checklist and known limitations in #eng-ops by EOD 2025-03-15.

Samir: Pricing Q — embeddings per-1k units and committed discounts for Dedicated. Where's the doc?

Maria: Pricing doc is being updated. Action: @Samir to own a short FAQ for Sales with example invoices by 2025-03-20.

Lydia: SDK migration — streaming API change was mentioned. Is there a compatibility matrix?

Elena: Short answer: v3 SDK will be backwards-compatible for basic calls but streaming has a new handler. Action: @Lydia to publish 'migration steps' gist + example snippets and link in the docs site by 2025-03-18.

Derek: Canary deploys — can we get an explicit checklist (load, perf, rollback) for Dedicated rollouts?

Sophia: Will do. Action: @Derek and @Sophia to co-author canary checklist and put it in the runbook repo: https://git.internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary.md (PR by 2025-03-17).

Maria: Ops note — recording, slides, and Q&A transcript: https://meetings.redwood.ai/ah/1860754321. If you answered a question live, please paste any follow-up notes here so we can close items.

deploy-bot: Recording uploaded and slides attached :white_check_mark:

Elena: Open ask — region expansion: EU next, APAC later in 2025. Action: @Elena to publish a short timeline for regions and partner dependencies by 2025-03-22.

Ajay: Customer asks about data residency for Dedicated vs Private — can Legal draft a short blurb we can use in sales decks?

Maria: I'll loop Legal. Action: @Maria to request a 2-paragraph approved blurb by 2025-03-19.

Samir: Can we get an owners table in this thread (owner, item, due)? That will help triage.

Maria: Yes — will compile into a tracker and ping channel when done. I'll update here when tracker is live.

Lydia: One more — examples for streaming in Node + Python would be huge. I'll prep examples and invite engineers to review.

Sophia: Noted. Engineers: please volunteer for review in #eng-runtime.

Maria: Thanks everyone. If anything else, drop it here. I'll close the loop after the tracker is published.
